intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Sacramento for 2026, and here is what he found: 29 family events, 14 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Theatre of Lights in Old Sacramento) through January 4, 2027 (Imaginarium at Cal Expo), with The Polar Express Train Ride (through December 21), Breakfast with Santa Aboard the Delta King (December 13) and Winter Wonderland at Fairytale Town (December 5 to 13) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
